title: Can I BEAT the Judit Polgar Bots?
summary: Valentine's Day video: chess.com Judit Polgár bots modelled on Judit at different ages, with age and rating shown (e.g. age 6; a ~1300-level bot; age 11 rated 2400). Tony gives himself White every game and climbs the ladder: beats level 1 (age 6) with a ladder mate, beats level 2, then is crushed by level 3 (age 11, 2400). Bots chat snarky/Valentine lines.
rules: Normal chess; player is White every game.
Ladder of Judit bots by age/rating; beat one to unlock the next (higher levels exist beyond 2400).
win_condition: Beat as many Judit bots as possible (reached level 3, lost).

opponent.name: Judit Polgár bots (age 6 → ... → age 11 2400 → higher)
opponent.avatar_description: cartoon Judit Polgár: long wavy light-brown hair, big smile, pink top, earrings (thumbnail 'Judit Polgar?')

events: Bot chat messages ('a game with you, good luck', snarky Valentine quips)
current_impl_issues: Impl gauntlet levels [1200,1700,2200,2500,2735] named Young/Prodigy/IM/GM/Peak Judit; video's ladder is by Judit's AGE with level 1 age 6 (beginner), level 2 ~1300-ish, level 3 age 11 = 2400. Adjust levels/names; player always White.
